title: Laravel Ignition debug mode is exposed
summary: The Ignition debug endpoint answers and reports it can run commands, the condition behind CVE-2021-3129, remote code execution.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and "html" not in header("content-type") and body_contains("can_execute_commands") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Turn debug mode off in production and update laravel-ignition.
